messages:
maria: heads up — acme-prod is getting a flood of 503/500s for hosted inference since 09:10 PDT. multiple customer requests timing out during streaming, they reported truncated responses and a few 500s. request_id=acme-req-9a3c.
kevin: oncall here, looking. do we have runner logs for that timeframe?
maria: attaching quick snippet from gateway logs (trimmed). 1 thread saw lots of upstream 502/503 before dropping to 500.
maria: ```
[2026-03-17T16:10:24Z] upstream: infer-runner-42 exit code=137 signal=SIGABRT
[2026-03-17T16:10:25Z] nvml: GPU 0 OOM, reserved 11.8G, free 200M
[2026-03-17T16:10:25Z] kernel: GPU page fault in task infer-runner (pid 4521)
[2026-03-17T16:10:26Z] containerd: container exited with status 137
```
aya: interesting — logs show both CUDA OOM and an abort path. could be OOM then abort handler yields segfault. any recent model/quant swap?
eng-oncall: we rolled a quantized variant of textgen-v3 to canary pool ~08:50 PDT for perf. canary had lower mem footprint in bench, but no large-context streaming run during test.
kevin: canary might be triggering a new codepath under long prefix/kvcache. ada: can we reproduce locally with long prompt?
aya: trying a focused repro now. using a 110k token-ish prompt that mimics their job (lots of toolcall sketches + few-shot). running on dev-gpu-8. reproducible crash after ~18k tokens emitted. stack shows invalid read in attention kernel.
maria: CS notes: customer was mid-demo to their board and is threatening to pause billing. they want ETA.
cs-rep: escalated to AM and flagged severity P1. told them we're investigating and will provide rolling mitigation.
kevin: immediate mitigation: enable fallback routing for acme-prod to model=textgen-v3-small in region us-west-2 and enable streaming_graceful_timeout=2s. rolling that now.
deploy-bot: updated routing rule: acme-prod -> fallback textgen-v3-small, rollout=50%
ops-bot: backoff policy increased for runner respawn: restart backoff=60s -> 180s for pool infer-canary
maria: customer updated: agreed to temporary fallback, asked for postmortem and billing credit estimate.
aya: repro notes: command I ran to reproduce (trimmed):
aya: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"textgen-v3-canary","input":"<very long prompt>...","stream":true}'
```
aya: runner coredump shows crash in aten::attn_fp_kernel.cu line ~312, and NVML reports sustained allocation growth before OOM. suspect kv-prefetch + quantized kernel regression.
kevin: next steps: 1) capture full nvml top and docker events during repro 2) mount runner with ASAN build and run single repro 3) collect coredump and nv-core-dump via /var/crash job. Creating debug job.
kevin: created job debug-1756003400 on devpool, added gdb + nvprof capture.
aya: debug job queued and started, uploading logs to s3 (s3://redwood-debug/1756003400). will link when available.
eng-oncall: also patching canary to disable aggressive kv-prefetch as short-term fix (kv_prefetch=off). will monitor.
maria: customer wants confirmation on billing credits. finance will estimate once we know outage window. I told them we expect to cover partial demo-impact credit; AM will confirm.
cs-rep: AM briefed. customer ok with fallback for now but wants timeline for root cause.
kevin: triage checklist created: reproduce with quant on long-context -> capture nvml + coredump -> bisect recent commit range (kernels+kv-prefetch) -> test patch. linking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-5921
aya: initial nvml dump: ```
GPU 0: used 11823 MiB / 12288 MiB, processes: infer-runner(4521)
Allocation growth pattern: +1.2GB every 2s until OOM
```
maria: leaving note for CS handoff: timeline and current mitigations (fallback + kv_prefetch off) in the support ticket.
kevin: will follow up with a brief postmortem and rollback plan. tagging eng kernel owners @aya @kevin.
maria: thanks — I'll keep the customer looped. will update thread when we have full dumps or rollback. :thumbsup:
